name: Sweet Bengal | Kandivali West
description: Sweet Bengal in Kandivali West is your neighborhood gateway to authentic Bengali sweets, crafted with care and tradition. From melt-in-your-mouth Sondesh to the rich flavors of Mishti Doi, Rosogolla, and Kheer Kodom, each bite offers a taste of Bengal’s timeless sweetness. Whether you're celebrating a festival or grabbing an everyday indulgence, Sweet Bengal delivers unmatched quality and freshness. Conveniently located, the store offers quick service and a wide variety of both sweets and savory snacks. Step in and experience the charm of Bengal’s culinary legacy right in the heart of Kandivali West.

Crafted with the finest cashews and pistachios, each bite delivers a perfect balance of crunch and melt-in-your-mouth chocolate richness. These sweets embody the heritage of Bengali confectionery, combining traditional flavors with a modern twist that delights every palate. Ideal for festivals, gifting, or personal indulgence, the Kaju Pista Chocolate Ball offers a luxurious experience in every piece, showcasing Sweet Bengal’s commitment to quality and authenticity. With elegant presentation and superior taste, this sweet has become a favorite among Kandivali West residents, reflecting the brand’s dedication to freshness and flavor. Discover the joy of fresh Bengali sweets and elevate your celebrations with this exquisite, nutty, chocolate-filled delight.

Experience the tropical sweetness of Sweet Bengal’s Mango Mania, a signature delight from the renowned Bengali dessert shop in Kandivali West. Each piece captures the essence of ripe, juicy mangoes, enveloped in a delicately smooth, melt-in-your-mouth casing that balances richness and freshness perfectly. This handcrafted dessert is a celebration of seasonal flavors, meticulously prepared to deliver an authentic taste of Bengal with every bite. Ideal for festive occasions, gifting, or a personal indulgence, Mango Mania exemplifies Sweet Bengal’s dedication to quality, tradition, and innovative flavor combinations. With vibrant presentation and the unmistakable aroma of fresh mango, it stands as a must-try treat for all dessert lovers. Discover the perfect blend of fruity sweetness and traditional Bengali craftsmanship at this Kandivali West sweet shop, and let every bite transport you to a world of indulgent delight.

Experience the authentic taste of Bengal with Sweet Bengal’s Kheerkodom, a signature delight from Kandivali West, Mumbai. This traditional Bengali sweet is crafted with utmost care, combining soft, melt-in-your-mouth khoya and a rich, creamy filling that captures the essence of classic Bengali confectionery. Each piece offers a perfect balance of sweetness and texture, reflecting the timeless recipes passed down through generations. Ideal for festivals, special occasions, or a simple indulgence, Kheerkodom embodies the artistry and dedication that Sweet Bengal brings to every creation. Known for its commitment to quality and authenticity, Sweet Bengal has become a trusted name for lovers of traditional Bengali sweets in Mumbai. With Kheerkodom, every bite transports you to the heart of Bengal, offering a luxurious, flavorful experience that celebrates heritage, taste, and tradition in every morsel.

Experience the exquisite taste of Sweet Bengal’s Dry Fruits sweets, a hallmark of authentic Bengali sweets in Kandivali West, Mumbai. These delicacies are crafted with precision, combining premium-quality nuts and dry fruits to create a rich, flavorful, and indulgent treat. Each piece is a perfect balance of sweetness and crunch, reflecting the traditional artistry and heritage of Bengali confectionery. Ideal for festivals, gifting, or savoring as a personal delight, these dry fruit sweets capture the essence of luxury and authenticity in every bite. Sweet Bengal in Kandivali West brings you the finest ingredients, carefully hand-prepared to ensure a memorable experience that transports you straight to the heart of Bengal’s rich culinary legacy. Celebrate every occasion with these authentic Bengali sweets that promise both indulgence and sophistication, making Sweet Bengal a true destination for connoisseurs of premium, handcrafted sweets.

Experience the authentic taste of Bengal with Sweet Bengal’s Daab Payesh, a signature delicacy from the best Bengali sweet shop in Kandivali West. This traditional dessert is prepared in tender coconut shells, offering a creamy, aromatic rice pudding infused with the natural sweetness of fresh coconut water and milk. Each serving is a perfect balance of rich, velvety texture and subtle flavors that transport you straight to the heart of Bengali culinary heritage. Ideal for festive celebrations, special occasions, or as a luxurious treat, the Daab Payesh reflects Sweet Bengal’s dedication to quality, tradition, and exquisite taste. With its unique presentation and heavenly flavor, it’s no wonder Sweet Bengal is celebrated as the go-to destination for authentic Bengali sweets in Kandivali West. featured_reviews.name: Hamza Kapadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly disappointing experience. The samosas and farsan were average at best and do not justify the hype or premium pricing.

What stood out more negatively was the owner’s rude and dismissive attitude. There is zero focus on customer service, which is unacceptable in a retail business. Customers are not doing you a favor by walking in—you are expected to treat them with basic respect and professionalism.

It seems that the brand is riding on strong legacy rather than maintaining real standards. Inheriting a name is one thing, but sustaining it through quality and customer focus is another—and this place clearly falls short on both.

Paying a premium only to be treated poorly is simply unacceptable. Not worth the visit unless there are serious improvements.

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
The owner is extremely rude and has no sense of how to talk to customers. He gave us one type of mithai to taste but was packing different mithai which was stale. When I complained about it, he started arguing instead of addressing the issue properly.

I walked out of the shop, and he then said, “Taste karne ka 20 rs dena hoga.” When I refused to pay, he replied, “Maine aapko daan kar diya, aise samjho.”

Very unprofessional behaviour and a disappointing experience. I would not recommend this shop to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
India is a country known for many religions, languages, cultures & colorful festivals. No wonder, in such a vibrant society, sweets are not simply consumable items. Sweets have deep-rooted social, traditional & spiritual relevance. Sweets, undoubtedly, convey the message of happiness, goodwill, celebrations, affection & attachment. We, Indians, believe in sharing the joy of life & the celebrations of life. And what are celebrations without sweets!

Unique quality, variety, novelty, taste & prompt service: these are some of the salient features of Madhuram sweets. Strict checking is done at every step, in the process of production, to ensure that the desired quality is achieved. By using innovative methods, they keep on producing sweets & namkeen to match with the taste & flavour of different seasons & festivals. Hence, they have an amazing variety of items to satisfy our esteemed customers.

Offering a wide assortment of delicious Indian sweets on the menu at pretty reason able prices, this shop is a local-favourite for buying and gifting sweets. It is touted to offers good quality products made using pure ingredients, and also offers toothsome snacking items, such as namkeen, mathri etc. Recommended - Samosa, Kalakand, Khaman Dhokla and Milk Cake.

Address :
Lt Road, Opposite Goyal Shopping Centre, Borivali West, Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Moorthy
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Rajubhai Dhoklawala is nothing short of a culinary paradise for Gujarati snack lovers! From the very first bite, their offerings transport you to the vibrant streets of Gujarat, where every flavor is packed with love and tradition. The Handvo is a savory revelation—perfectly crisp on the outside, with a moist, spiced, and hearty interior that delights with every mouthful.

Their selection of dhoklas is an absolute masterpiece. Whether it’s the classic soft, airy khaman or the spiced variations, each piece melts in your mouth, leaving you yearning for more. The vibrant flavors, balanced with just the right amount of tang and sweetness, create a perfect symphony of Gujarati gastronomy.

And let’s not forget their samosas—delicate, flaky crusts encasing a flavorful mix of spiced potatoes, peas, and more. Each variety is a new adventure in taste, a crispy, golden delight that is impossible to resist. As for the sweets, the churma ladoos are the crowning jewel—rich, crumbly, and packed with ghee and jaggery goodness, they melt in your mouth, creating a festival of flavors that linger long after.

Rajubhai Dhoklawala captures the essence of Gujarati street food and brings it to your plate with unparalleled authenticity. If you haven’t yet indulged in this treasure trove of flavors, you’re truly missing out on one of life’s greatest culinary pleasures!

featured_reviews.name: Kumar Pai
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're ever around Kandivali West railway station and craving some delicious vegetarian snacks, Jain Sweet & Bhelpuri House is a spot you absolutely shouldn't miss.

This iconic eatery has been around for over 50 years — and for good reasons. It's one of those gems that has stood the test of time while keeping both quality and taste intact.

The outlet is best known for its wide range of traditional Indian mithai , from classic laddus and pedas to melt-in-the-mouth barfis. If you're a fan of Bengali sweets, their rasgullas and cham chams won’t disappoint. Plus, they’ve got sugar-free options too, which is great if you’re watching your sugar intake but still want to enjoy a treat.

Now let’s talk about the savory side - this is where the place really shines for me. Their chaat is absolutely top-tier. The bhel puri is a crowd favorite, but honestly, everything is good.

We keep going back for their chole bhature, dahi vada, and dahi batata puri — they’re just next-level. The flavors are perfectly balanced, and you can tell everything’s freshly made.

Other must-tries include their samosas, kachoris, pani puri, sabudana vada and vada pav .

The place is clean, hygienic, and run efficiently, even during peak hours.

Over the years, they’ve expanded with branches near Kandivali East Station Road and Mahavir Nagar in Kandivali West, which is super convenient.

If you’re a vegetarian foodie or just love good Indian street-style snacks and sweets, this place is a must-visit.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jain Sweet & Bhelpuri HouseJain Sweet & Bhelpuri House, Kandivali

Jain Sweet & Bhelpuri House, located near Kandivali Railway Station, is a well-known establishment offering a variety of sweets and savory snacks. The shop boasts an extensive selection of traditional Indian sweets, including laddus, pedas, barfis, and Bengali specialties like rasgullas and cham chams. For those mindful of sugar intake, they also provide sugar-free options.

On the savory side, the eatery is celebrated for its chaat items, with the bhel puri being a standout favorite. Other popular offerings include samosas, kachoris, Punjabi chole puri, sabudana vada, and pattice. The baked cheese vada pav, stuffed with vegetables, batata vada, and cheese, and grilled to perfection, comes highly recommended.

Customers have praised the establishment for its hygienic food preparation and quick service. The shop's proximity to the station makes it a convenient spot for a quick bite. Given its popularity, the place often sees a steady stream of patrons, so ordering online might be a practical option during peak hours.

Overall, Jain Sweet & Bhelpuri House offers a delightful experience for those seeking traditional Indian sweets and savory snacks .

featured_reviews.name: Food Lover
featured_reviews.review_text:
6 months ago, I had bought jalebi from this place — it was made in pure ghee and was very crispy. You could actually taste the richness of ghee in every bite. Trusting that same quality, I bought it again today, but this time it was made in regular oil. The price was ₹150 for just 250 grams. This is nothing short of cheating customers.  You can get 250 grams of jalebi for just ₹90 outside Andheri station — That makes this place not only overpriced but also deceptive in terms of quality.

I also noticed a review below where someone complained about their dahi bhalla — clearly, this isn't a one-off issue.

Please stop misleading people and cheating customers.

featured_reviews.name: Anirbaan Saha
featured_reviews.review_text: This restaurant serves the purpose every time. If you are someone who travels in western railway and feels hungry after getting down at Kandivili station...then you can grab a quick bite of snacks from this  place. They have a small sitting arrangement and the food delivery time is 3-4 min (Yes I have timed it :P ) . Food is decent and the waiters are very efficient. I have tried this place many time but so far I haven’t had any bad experience.

featured_reviews.name: Nilay Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dahi Puri for 90Rs. Extremely overpriced. Taste was not at all good. Offered just 5 puris for 90rs. The person preparing chat was very arrogant and rude when asked for sukha puri,he denied sukha puri saying, we only give sukha puri with pani puri, like seriously?😂.
There are many other food vendors nearby. I highly recommend not to visit this shop and please prefer other food vendors over this.

featured_reviews.name: Hinal Malavia
featured_reviews.review_text:
A fast food joint just outside kandivali railway station serving since years. They first started with vada pav then chats then chole bhature then pav bhaji and sweets.i have been visiting this place since childhood and i love many dishes here.

I had cheese girlled vada pav which was very good it had vada between buns with onions capsicum beetroot with cheese slice and it tasted very good.

The farali pattice was very good and soft and hot it was served with white coconut chutney.

Dahi puri was veryy good.. the dahii was pure fresh and sweet with chutneys and masala topped with sev just loved it.

The ragda pattice wasnt that good it was okaish the radga was soggy.

Chole bhature was damn good they serve 2 bhatura and one bowl of chole one would jst lovee eating it.

Cheese pav bhaji was great and the taste of bhajii was very delicious.

Malai sandwich has always been the best selling there.

Gulab jamun was soft and very good made of mawa and veryy good.

The kulfi falooda was jst fine we didnt like it much.

featured_reviews.name: Tanvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Swiggy Order Review:

The so called Lunchbox cake, prized at Rs. 299, was so small that it fitted in a Pastry box. I was surprised to see that how nicely some shops can fool us. The Choco Mocha pastry was easily the worst pastry I've ever tried, that too priced at a whopping 199! Both the things had the driest & most tasteless sponges ever. Felt like I'm eating a piece of bread! I paid Rs. 450 for them (post discount) whereas they didn't even feel worth 200 rs.

Upar se Swiggy delivery also ruined the "Looks" of the pastries. Was delivered on cycle, imagine the results. But still if you're charging Rs.299 for such a pastry, you should be smart enough to atleast include a cake board beneath so that it stays away from box?! Such experiences make me never try a new cake shop! Photos will tell the rest.

Thankfully we had a bigger & "Proper" cake from another shop otherwise our occasion would've been ruined!
